_about: Written by the REAL daemon: Codex's plan card (a replay of the measured plan turn) and OpenCode's mode rows with one agent of the user's. Regenerate with IJ_REGEN_BUILD_APP_V1441=1.

codex_plan_card.title: Start working on this plan
codex_plan_card.plan:
1. Open `a.txt` and append a new line containing `two`.
2. Verify the file now includes the added line.

opencode_modes.label: Ask first
opencode_modes.about: Asks before it changes a file, runs a command or uses the web; reads without asking. It starts no helpers here.

opencode_modes.label: Auto edits
opencode_modes.about: Changes files without asking; asks before it runs a command or uses the web. It starts no helpers here.

opencode_modes.label: Plan
opencode_modes.about: OpenCode's plan agent: it looks and plans, and changes no file. It starts no helpers here.

opencode_modes.label: docs
opencode_modes.about: Writes docs only. OpenCode's own agent “docs”. Asks first, except where the agent's own permission rules say otherwise. It starts no helpers here.

codex_modes.label: Ask first
codex_modes.about: Asks before every command and every file change.

codex_modes.label: Plan
codex_modes.about: Codex's own plan mode: it looks and plans, changes no file and asks before every command. You approve its plan before it starts.

codex_hidden.label: Auto
codex_hidden.reason: Codex's Auto review lets a reviewer model of Codex's own answer each approval instead of you. It is not offered here: Iron Jarvis cannot show you yet what that reviewer decided.

codex_hidden.label: Auto edits
codex_hidden.reason: On Windows, Codex can run commands only with its own file protection switched off, and then it asks either before every file change and every command, or before none of them. It has no setting where edits run on their own while commands still ask. Codex's own Windows protection for commands is not set up on this PC, and Iron Jarvis does not set it up.
